column1: # US CBSA metros (metro, not micro, not CSA). Population: Census 2023 vintage,
# rank-rounded, game-plausible like nations.ts. Bake takes the top 200.
# demShare: 2020 two-party Democratic presidential share (MIT Election Lab
# county returns, population-weighted to CBSA). Smaller metros use regional
# approximations of the same vintage. Range 0..1.
# kind: capital = Washington only; port = coastal major port; border = land
# border metro; industrial = rust-belt / manufacturing allowlist (includes
# Pittsburgh); financial = Chicago, San Francisco, San Jose, Charlotte, Hartford;
# else interior. New York and Boston stay port (original six).
